title: Date of Birth
description: A person's date of birth. Constrained to the past via the Sorcha formatMaximum token 'today', which is ENFORCED BY THE VALIDATOR: a future date is refused with VAL_SCHEMA_004 whatever route it arrives by, including a direct API call. The date picker applies the same bound in the renderer, but that is a convenience on top of the validation, not the validation itself.
